column1: # Given names of persons with Slovenian citizenship in Wikidata (property P735, CC0),
# those with two or more bearers, without foreign names (Ben, Jean, Thomas), those spelled
# like a common word or a company (Pika, Bor, Vital), and names in -a with less than half the
# bearers of the man's name whose genitive they are spelled like (Miroslava, Bojana, Metoda:
# Miroslava Krleže is a genitive). slovenian_words.py writes them into formant_slovenian.inc;
# after one of them a capitalized word in a consonant and -e is a surname (surname_reading()).
